steps.text: Add 1/8 cup soy sauce to the bowl
Add 1 tablespoon honey to the bowl
Add 1 teaspoon cornstarch to the bowl
Peel 2 cloves of garlic
mince garlic
Add 2 cloves minced garlic to the bowl
Add 1/2 tablespoon minced ginger to the bowl
Add 1/8 teaspoon black pepper to the bowl
Add 1/6 cup water the bowl
Whisk the contents of bowl
Set aside the sauce mixture
Take 2 cremini mushrooms
slice mushrooms
Take 1 bell pepper
slice 1/3 of the bell pepper
Take 5 in number broccoli florets
Heat 2 tablespoons olive oil in a skillet over medium-high heat
add sliced mushrooms to the skillet
Add broccoli to the skillet
cook, stirring often, for 4 minutes. If the pan gets too hot on medium-high, turn the heat down to medium
Add bell pepper to the skillet
continue cooking, stirring often, for 2-3 minutes, until vegetables are crisp-tender
Whisk the sauce again to recombine the ingredients
Pour the sauce into the skillet
cook, stirring, for 1 minute until the sauce thickens
